headline: Contested Fronts Report Fresh Strategic Movement
war_summary: The latest watch shows the ownership ledger growing more unsettled on several fronts. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest sector, with 47 changes over 24 hours and five in the latest two-hour window; its nine bases stand four Warden to five Colonial. Weathered Expanse also records nine recent changes and 27 for the day, leaving control split four Warden and five Colonial. Deadlands has added two daily events since the previous edition, including five in the latest watch, while its eleven bases remain entirely Colonial-held despite the heavy fighting. Godcrofts has quickened sharply, posting seven events in two hours and 13 across the day; its ledger reads three Warden to six Colonial. Linn’s Mercy has likewise become active, with five fresh changes and nine over 24 hours, while seven of eleven bases remain Warden-held. Stonecradle’s 18 daily events leave it at seven Warden bases and two Colonial, though no movement appears in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage and Fisherman’s Row show no new recent changes, while most other sectors remain quiet by comparison.
